desc:
PANTRY ESSENTIAL: Made with 100% whole grain oats for a morning food your whole family can enjoy; Keep a box on hand as the perfect pantry staple that's ready to eat any time

CAN HELP LOWER CHOLESTEROL as part of a heart healthy diet; 3g of soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, like Cheerios, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease - Cheerios provides 1.5g per serving

GLUTEN FREE CEREAL: Pour some in a bowl with milk for a great-tasting, gluten free part of an easy breakfast; Pack some in a lunch box or backpack for snacks on the go; Add to homemade cereal bars as snacks for kids

WHOLESOME INGREDIENTS: Provides 34g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), a good source of calcium and fiber, and 11 vitamins and minerals per serving; No artificial flavors or colors

CONTAINS: One 8.9 oz box of Cheerios Breakfast Cereal
features:
Features

Made with Whole Grain Oats

Crafted with 100% whole grain oats as the first ingredient, providing heart-healthy nutrition and a hearty crunch.

Touch of Real Honey & Almond Flavor

Naturally flavored with real honey and a hint of almond for a mildly sweet taste.

Gluten-Free Certified

Suitable for people with gluten intolerance or celiac disease.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors

Free from artificial additives, making it a clean and trustworthy breakfast choice.

Fortified with 12 Essential Vitamins & Minerals

Includes iron, calcium, zinc, and several B vitamins to support everyday health.

Low in Fat & Cholesterol-Free

Supports heart health by keeping saturated fat and cholesterol content low.

Kid-Friendly Shape and Flavor

The signature O-shape and light sweetness make it appealing to both kids and adults.

Benefits

Heart-Healthy Choice

Contains soluble fiber from whole grain oats, which may help lower cholesterol as part of a heart-conscious diet.

Balanced Energy Source

Provides a good balance of carbohydrates, fiber, and protein to keep you energized throughout the morning.

Safe for Gluten-Sensitive Individuals

Clearly labeled and processed in a gluten-free environment to ensure safety for those with dietary restrictions.

Versatile Use

Great as a breakfast cereal, dry snack, or even in recipes like snack mixes and cereal bars.

Supports Overall Wellness

Nutrient-rich and low in sugar (compared to other sweet cereals), making it a smarter choice for daily consumption.

Trusted Family Staple

A consistent, reliable cereal option that’s been loved for generations for its taste and nutritional profile.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Corn Starch, Sugar, Salt, Tripotassium Phosphate. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
